title: The shriek of the structure sheaf along a flat morphism is relatively perfect and self-dual
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a flat morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S the lemma asserts that f^!O_Y is Y-perfect and that O_X -> RSheafHom(f^!O_Y, f^!O_Y) is an isomorphism (statement lines 4889-4897). Both assertions being local on X, the proof reduces to affine X and Y, where Remark labelled remark-local-calculation-shriek turns the statement into the algebraic Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-relative-dualizing-algebraic of Dualizing Complexes, and Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-affine-locally-rel-perfect is used to match the language of relatively perfect complexes with the algebraic notion (proof lines 4899-4906). Translating relative perfection and the self-duality equation into the affine algebraic statement is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
